nodes.label: Wooden Fence Prop (Variant 1)
nodes.description: Pixel art wooden fence section, dark brown planks with crossbar supports. Small horizontal prop for level decoration.

nodes.label: Wooden Fence Prop (Variant 2)
nodes.description: Pixel art wooden fence section, dark brown planks with crossbar — slight visual variant of fence_1 for scene variety.

nodes.label: Oak Woods Ground Tileset
nodes.description: Modular tileset sprite sheet with dark stone/earth platform tiles, corner pieces, edge connectors, and gold-rimmed surface tiles. Contains multiple tile variants arranged on transparent background for composing platformer terrain.

nodes.label: Small Rock Ground Prop
nodes.description: Tiny dark mossy rock pixel art sprite for ground-level environmental decoration. Flat, squat shape.

nodes.label: Wooden Signpost Prop
nodes.description: Dark pixel art wooden T-shaped signpost with no readable text — classic RPG wayfinding prop for scene dressing.

nodes.label: Animated Shop Building Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: Horizontal sprite sheet with 6 animation frames of a fantasy shop building. Stone walls, purple tiled roof, hanging lanterns, glowing magical particle effects above chimney-like towers, and a visible 'SHOP' banner sign. Used for animated background or interactable building.

nodes.label: Background Layer 1 — Misty Far Forest
nodes.description: Farthest parallax background layer. Muted blue-lavender color scheme depicting a misty forest with silhouetted bare leafless trees and low ground shrubs. Low contrast atmosphere creates strong depth separation from foreground layers.

nodes.label: Background Layer 2 — Purple Oak Forest Mid
nodes.description: Mid-distance parallax background layer. Dark purple tones with large oak trees bearing full purple foliage canopies and ground-level shrubs. Higher contrast than layer 1, bringing the forest closer to the viewer. The white/transparent center gap suggests this layer frames the sides of the play area.
nodes.norm_label: background layer 2 — purple oak forest mid

nodes.label: Fighting Game — Oak Woods Level Environment
nodes.description: Composite level environment concept for the FightingGame's oak woods stage. Combines parallax background layers, foreground props (fences, rocks, sign, shop), and ground tileset to create a 2D fighting stage set in a forested fantasy village setting.
nodes.norm_label: fighting game — oak woods level environment

nodes.label: FightingGame (SIH Project Mini-Game)
nodes.description: 2D pixel art fighting mini-game within the SIH gamified learning platform. Uses oak woods themed assets for its stage environment.
